detail.longDescription: Vancouver web-hosting advice needed! Since being deleted by the US Gov (see previous toot), I need an affordable host upon which to rebuild my site. I have my own .ca domain, but want to host my content on a Vancouver-based server that does not use .org, .com or any other US infrastructure (because .org was the reason my previous site was vulnerable). Please advise!! (& should I quit wordpress?) # internetssovereignty # fascism # antifa # webhosting # vancouver # canada # webdev # website # wordpress
